# Modèle de sortie – workshop client (anglais)

Format de la note **Meeting** (diffusable, sans marqueur de source ; chaque élément porte un ID tracé dans les working notes). Structure, style et diffusion : regles-compte-rendu.md.

## Meeting information
| Title | Date / time / duration | Location / link | Organizer | Minute-taker |
|---|---|---|---|---|
- **Present**: · **Absent / excused**: · **Distribution** (incl. absentees): · **Classification**: · **Version / status**:

## Summary
1-3 sentences: purpose and outcome.

## Decisions
| ID (D1…) | Decision | Decided by | Rationale (1 line) |

## Actions
| ID (A1…) | Action (verb + deliverable) | Owner (one person) | Side (us / customer) | Due (YYYY-MM-DD) | Done when | Status |
Owners / due dates to confirm: …

## Previous actions review
| ID (previous meeting) | Action | Owner | Status (done / in progress / late / cancelled) | New due |

## Discussion by agenda item
### 1. <agenda item>
- 2-4 key points, not a transcript

## Customer requirements stated or changed
| ID (R1…) | Requirement (quoted) | New / changed / confirmed | Related ticket or spec |

## Commitments made by our side ⚠️
| ID (C1…) | Commitment | Who said it | Condition / deadline |

## Potential scope changes ⚠️
| ID (S1…) | Change | Why it is a change |

## Divergences from our documentation
| Topic | Customer said | Our documentation says |

## Customer terminology
| Customer term | Our term / meaning |

## Open questions
| ID (Q1…) | Question | Owner (us / customer) | Due |

## Parking lot
| Topic | Next step | Owner |

## Next meeting
Date · objective

## References
Documents, pages, tickets, recording.

---
## Draft email – minutes for confirmation (dans les **working notes**, livrable N2, ne pas envoyer)
- Objet : `[<Project>] Workshop <topic> – <date> – minutes for confirmation`
- Destinataires : participants **et absents** concernés ; envoi sous 24 h.
- Contenu : decisions, our understanding of the requirements, commitments (both sides),
  **actions with owner and due date**, open questions with owners, next meeting.
  Actions sans responsable ou date : « Owner / due date to be confirmed ».
- Demande : « Please confirm or correct by <date + 5 working days>. Without feedback by then, we will
  consider these minutes as agreed. »
- Ton courtois et factuel ; aucun engagement de date, périmètre ou coût absent des sources ;
  contenu repris uniquement de la note Meeting (jamais des working notes).
